item.title: SNAPPED: Full moon peeks through the clouds
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. — Jacksonites had their monthly opportunity to howl at a full moon last night when the February “Snow Moon” put on a show as it rose over the valley after the clouds abated. Buckrail photographer Nick Sulzer snapped some photos of the moon glowing through a diaphanous haze. item.title: Game and Fish to partner with NMWA to host free drawing tutorial
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. — On Thursday, Feb. 5, the Wyoming Game and Fish Department and the National Museum of Wildlife Art (NMWA) are teaming up to host a live YouTube tutorial to teach young artists how to draw an arctic grayling. item.title: County announces retirement of longtime staffer Jodie Pond
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. — Teton County has announced the upcoming retirement of the Board of County Commissioners’ Administrator Jodie Pond. The County said in a statement on Monday that Pond will retire later this year, after 13 years with Teton County. She served as Teton County’s Director of Health from 2013 to 2024.
